heroHeadline: Civil Commission Final Report: Oct. 7 Sexual Violence Was Systematic, Deliberate Strategy — New Findings Include Abuse of Minors; Netanyahu Partially Concedes Responsibility on CBS
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. On May 12, 2026 (Day 948 / Ceasefire Day 215), the Civil Commission on October 7th Crimes by Hamas — an independent two-year investigation led by Dr. Cochav Elkayam-Levy — published its comprehensive final report concluding that sexual violence during the October 7 attack was 'systematic, widespread, and integral' to Hamas's strategy: a deliberate military policy, not spontaneous acts. New findings include previously undisclosed evidence of sexual abuse of minors. Every case was cross-referenced with independent witness accounts and forensic evidence; the report is expected to support ICC proceedings. Separately, the Jerusalem Post (May 12) analyzed Netanyahu's CBS 60 Minutes interview in which he made his first explicit partial acknowledgment of accountability — 'everybody bears some responsibility, from the prime minister down' — but did not commit to any specific investigation mechanism and reiterated his preferred government-controlled commission. Haaretz polling showed 37% of Likud-leaning voters cite Oct. 7 failures as a reason to reconsider the party; 75%+ of Israelis want Netanyahu to step down. 50 days remain until the Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 deadline for the government to present an investigation framework. Hamas's 1,195-death attack of October 7, 2023 — which triggered 251 hostage-takings (all accounted for as of January 26, 2026) and Operation Swords of Iron — remains the unresolved accountability wound at the heart of Israeli politics. Gaza ceasefire remains highly volatile: Israel controls 60%+ of Gaza, Hamas holds firm on disarmament refusal, 850+ Palestinians killed since October 2025 ceasefire, IDF operational plans for resumed offensive complete pending US authorization.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Israel Police, UN OCHA, Israeli government, Bloomberg, Reuters, AP, Haaretz, Times of Israel, Jerusalem Post, WAFA, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are official Israeli counts; Hamas-theater figures are separately noted and contested. All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026. Ceasefire in effect since Oct 10, 2025; 2,400+ violations documented — 850+ Palestinians killed since ceasefire as of May 12, 2026 (ACLED: April 2026 deadliest month of year, 140 fatalities). May 12 (Day 948): Civil Commission final report — Oct. 7 sexual violence systematic, widespread, deliberate strategy; new findings on sexual abuse of minors; Netanyahu partially concedes Oct. 7 responsibility on CBS 60 Minutes (Jerusalem Post analysis); 50 days to July 1 Supreme Court investigation deadline. ICC arrest warrants for Netanyahu and Gallant remain active. Gaza reconstruction cost: $71.4B per UN-EU-World Bank joint assessment; <$1B of $17B pledged received.
